header.dataset_source: HistData.com ASCII paired XAUUSD ticks; fixed EST UTC-05:00
header.dependency_scope: Bound overlay versions; existing image Pydantic/Pydantic-core recorded without replacement. Platform/base-version differences are not assigned causal significance.
header.hold_scope: Original actual backtest.simulate reference retained, including sparse equity marks and expired-intent semantics; no synthetic per-step hold trace claimed
header.scope: offline own cash/inventory/peak trajectory in actual source image; no Store/app/database/network/registration/account/broker integration
header.stress_scope: runtime uses own raw-bid input peak; native scenario accounting uses widened spread mark; these differ deliberately in stress and are not pure floating-point differences

end.acceptance: completeness/conservation/actual-refusals-included only; no zero-timeout, bitwise identity, profitability or eligibility requirement

scope: Read-only reconstruction and full result comparison; no inference/env/policy/training rerun, SSH, Store, registration or ledger write.
qualification: Equality/differences are diagnostic only. This does not change frozen profit gates, activate models or prove source transfer/online execution.
timing_limit: Recorded successful wall_ms may exceed the post-check instant after preemption; do not infer missing timeout solely from later elapsed logging.
no_refusal_limit: If actual_refusals=0, Linux refusal preservation has no observed event evidence; prior synthetic rejection tests remain separate.
